sloka: अदृश्यं सर्वमनुजैः सशरीरं महाबलम् ।प्रगृह्य लक्ष्मणं शक्रस्त्रिदिवं संविवेश ह ।। ७.१०६.१७ ॥
transliteration: adṛśyaṁ sarvamanujaiḥ saśarīraṁ mahābalam ।pragṛhya lakṣmaṇaṁ śakrastridivaṁ saṁviveśa ha ।। 7.106.17 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, Indra took the mighty Lakshmana, who was invisible to all humans and still in his physical body, and entered heaven.
